rationale: Cluster validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet groups t02-chinese-alias (Pattern B) and t05-collection (Pattern C / split-monolith). The current workflow goes straight from `buildPack` to `node $SK extract` with no archetype-specific pre-flight. Adding an explicit pre-validation walkthrough inside Step 4 — keyed to Pattern B (E4/E5/E13) and collection (E11/W2/W4) — gives the agent a deterministic place to catch the rules most likely to bite these two archetypes, complementing the expanded cheat sheet.
expected_effect: Agent gains an explicit, archetype-keyed pre-flight inside Step 4 that directly addresses the two failed tasks: Pattern B libraries will pre-check the idMap against entity ids (E4) before extraction, and collection libraries will pre-check asset registration and on-disk existence (E11/W2/W4) before extraction. This shifts rule-coverage errors from a post-validate surprise to a pre-extraction check.
regression_risk: Adds one bullet block + two short archetype lists inside Step 4; no existing step is removed or shortened, and Steps 1–3b/5/6 are untouched. Passing tasks (id-based, multi-stage, external-JSON) follow the existing Step 4 path; the new pre-flight is additive guidance. Slight risk that the extra bullets cause an agent to over-engineer a simple id-based task — mitigated because the bullets are explicitly keyed to archetype, not mandatory for all paths.
